## Status

Status is a declared field. Authors set it. It is not inferred from git or CI.

<div class="entity-table">
<table>
<thead>
<tr><th>Value</th><th>Kind</th><th>Meaning</th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr><td data-label="Value"><code>open</code></td><td data-label="Kind">live</td><td data-label="Meaning">Filed. Work has not started.</td></tr>
<tr><td data-label="Value"><code>ready</code></td><td data-label="Kind">live</td><td data-label="Meaning">Ready to become a plan.</td></tr>
<tr><td data-label="Value"><code>in-progress</code></td><td data-label="Kind">live</td><td data-label="Meaning">A plan is in flight, or close-out is underway.</td></tr>
<tr><td data-label="Value"><code>blocked</code></td><td data-label="Kind">live</td><td data-label="Meaning">Waiting on named work.</td></tr>
<tr><td data-label="Value"><code>closed</code></td><td data-label="Kind">terminal</td><td data-label="Meaning">Finished. Requires a Resolution section and traceability.</td></tr>
<tr><td data-label="Value"><code>replaced</code></td><td data-label="Kind">terminal</td><td data-label="Meaning">A named successor took over. Requires replaced-by.</td></tr>
<tr><td data-label="Value"><code>canceled</code></td><td data-label="Kind">terminal</td><td data-label="Meaning">Abandoned. A reason is optional.</td></tr>
<tr><td data-label="Value"><code>obsoleted</code></td><td data-label="Kind">terminal</td><td data-label="Meaning">Shipped, then removed with no 1:1 successor. Requires obsoleted-by.</td></tr>
</tbody>
</table>
</div>

<div class="entity-illegal">
<p>Illegal</p>
<ul>
<li>Any other status name</li>
<li><code>replaced</code> without <code>replaced-by</code></li>
<li><code>obsoleted</code> without <code>obsoleted-by</code></li>
<li><code>deprecated</code> (spec and bundle only)</li>
<li>A spec for an issue</li>
<li>Both <code>delivered_by</code> and <code>resolved-by</code> on the same close</li>
</ul>
</div>

## Constraints

- Bounded work uses issue → plan
- An issue does not get a spec
- Do not hand-write an issue into existence
- Close requires a Resolution section and exactly one of delivered_by or resolved-by, unless the issue carries its own requirements and claims

## Validate

<pre><code>backstop artifact validate --issue ISSUE-NNN</code></pre>

## Reviewer

Issues do not have a dedicated reviewer agent.

- The validator checks the schema
- A plan reviewer reads the issue when a plan is created from it

## Notes

Bounded work uses issue → plan. This is the normal path for a bug, a follow-on, or a small fix.

Product code is not written from the issue. The implementer executes an approved plan.
